How the Hormuz crisis handed America a lasting export advantage

With the Strait of Hormuz unreliable, American exporters of LNG, LPG, jet fuel and plastics have won customers and routes lost by Middle East suppliers. US LNG shipments to Asia rose 108% in the first half of 2026, US propane exports hit a record 2.1m barrels a day in April, and some of the new business has been locked in with contracts stretching decades ahead.

霍尔木兹海峡受阻后，美国 LNG、丙烷、航煤和塑料出口商抢下中东供应商流失的客户与航线。2026 年上半年美国对亚洲 LNG 出口同比增长 108%，4 月美国丙烷出口创下每日 210 万桶纪录；部分合作已签下长达数十年的长约。

The collective capacity of empty VLCCs and Suezmaxes sailing to load Middle East crude has fallen about 40% since end-August, Tankertrackers.com data show.
